sentence: This project builds interfaces that help teams of people safely supervise autonomous drone swarms.
This project designs ways to reason about programs that include deep neural networks by measuring how uncertain the networks' predictions are.
This project builds software toolkits that help AI development use less power.
This project builds a framework to design and verify learning-enabled systems made of unreliable components.
This project builds a model that links heart muscle cells and tissue to how the heart works in health and disease.
This project uses water chemistry and flow data from rivers to find out how and why substances in rivers change through the year.
This project studies Coherent Ising Machines, which solve optimization problems using optical and electronic components.
This project builds a research module that combines AI with bioinformatics to analyze biological data.
This project uses computer simulations to find out why carbon dots glow in different colors.
This project creates cybersecurity course modules and laboratory exercises that use cloud computing.
This project builds a 3D infrared spectrometer to study the structure and behavior of gaseous molecules.
This project develops an additive manufacturing method that prints molten biothermoplastics inside a high-temperature liquid support bath.
This project builds a remotely accessible testbed that uses robotics and AI to run biomanufacturing experiments.
This project studies how white rhinoceros and termites affect each other and, through that, plant growth and nutrient cycling.
This project builds a program assessment method based on concept maps for learning analytics.
